title: Tabulation Machine Computes the Function
statement: For every Boolean finite Turing machine $M$, the tabulation machine built from $M$ computes the function that sends each Boolean word $y$ to the one-symbol output consisting of the tabulation function’s value on $y$, within time bound $10(n+1)2^n$ on inputs of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Boolean finite Turing machine
